title: Expander Mixing Bound for Subsets
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $A$ be a symmetric real $n\times n$ matrix with nonnegative entries and every row summing to $1$. Let $\lambda(A)$ be the supremum of $\|Av\|$ over unit vectors orthogonal to the constant vector with every coordinate $1/n$, and suppose $\lambda(A)\leq\lambda$. For subsets $S,T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the indicator vectors satisfy
\[\left|\langle 1_S,A1_T\rangle-\frac{|S||T|}{n}\right|\leq \lambda\sqrt{|S||T|}.\]
